ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 0.12:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/yellowish barnacle clusters and scratches) to low-intensity (primary dark pigmentation) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity field covering >85% of surface; high-contrast localized geometric blobs situated at the distal tips of both lobes and along the peaks of the trailing edge serrations; sparse linear high-intensity streaks distributed across the central-left region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 88 degrees and a relative depth extending roughly 12% into the fluke body from the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with varying pixel-amplitudes (range 3-15 pixels) creating a non-uniform jagged boundary; most prominent on the upper margins of the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both lobes, with the right lobe (viewer perspective) showing a more pronounced distal taper compared to the truncated appearance of the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal extremities and along the superior trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, unaligned high-intensity linear markings (rake marks/scratches) observed primarily on the left-central surface area, cutting across the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral epibiotic colonization (barnacles) resulting in irregular structural thickening and high-contrast color shifts on the fluke margins.
